summary: Post-fix verification of CR-385 front-desk mockup v2.26. Read-only run against the public URL. 24 of 27 audited QA items PASS; 2 defects remain (P1 money-integrity mismatch on the QA-002/QA-009 noshow-prepaid seed, and a P2 Check-In header dismiss label missing the '✕' glyph). No source files were modified. Zero console errors on every hook exercised.

ui_bugs.component: Ans (F. Almeida) OTA prepaid seed vs QA-002/QA-009 spec
ui_bugs.issue: P1 · Measured on ?open=ans:noshow — noshow-prepaid = ₹9,450 (expected ₹9,000 per spec 'Suite 4500 × 2'); consequently noshow-refund-due = ₹4,725 (expected ₹4,275). Penalty ₹4,500, noshow-sgst −₹112.50, noshow-cgst −₹112.50, noshow-deducted −₹4,725 are all internally consistent. Root cause: seed line 355 sets prepaid = Math.round(bookingCharge(a)*1.05) i.e. adds 5% GST into the 'prepaid/advance' amount, but the QA-002 spec (and all other Advance/PAH labels in the mock) treat prepaid as the BASE booking charge, not GST-inclusive. Bookings for OTAs elsewhere carry a PREPAID badge with a GST-inclusive amount (e.g. Suite × 2 = ₹9,000 label vs seed ₹9,450 stored) — cross-screen visual amount still reads ₹9,000 on the Arrivals row (arr[i].amt = RATE[type]) but the No-Show dialog uses the GST-inclusive prepaid. Deviation ≈ ₹450.

P2 · QA-014 requires the header ✕ button on Check-In to read exactly '✕ Close'. Actual: `[data-testid=checkin-close-button]` inner text is 'Close' (no '✕' glyph). Source line 699. All other dialog headers (Bill/Extend/Modify/Booking/NoShow/Cancel/RoomDetail/Mark-All-Clean) render '✕ Close' correctly.

P3 · When Extend collect exceeds total-payable (?room=101:extend, collect=999999, Cash) the confirm button is correctly disabled and readiness reads 'To complete: Amount ≤ total payable' (fixed ✓). However the 'Balance remaining' cell still prints '−₹9,96,534' below the field — cosmetic since Confirm is blocked, but a clamp at 0 would read cleaner.

ui_bugs.component: No-Show / Cancel dialog header dismiss buttons lack data-testid
ui_bugs.issue: P3 · Header ✕ Close buttons for `[data-testid=noshow-dialog]` and `[data-testid=cancel-dialog]` have no data-testid of their own (lines 626, 640). Text is correct ('✕ Close') via source inspection, but automated coverage of the QA-014 close-label rule cannot key on a stable id — recommend adding noshow-close-button / cancel-close-button (and noshow-cancel-button / cancel-cancel-button on the footers).

action_items: Fix seed line 355 → set OTA prepaid to bookingCharge(a) (no ×1.05) so QA-002 noshow-prepaid = ₹9,000 and QA-009 refund-due = ₹4,275; OR update the spec expectation. Guests also compute `Math.round(bookingCharge(g)*1.05)` at line 356 — same GST-included assumption; keep or drop consistently.
Add '✕ ' prefix to `[data-testid=checkin-close-button]` inner text (line 699) to satisfy QA-014.
Optional: clamp extend-balance-remaining at 0 for cleaner rendering; add testids on the no-show / cancel dialog dismiss buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: v2.26 successfully consolidated the four sources of 'booking amount' into one `bookingCharge(o)` helper (line 349) with `folioOf` / `billD` derivations — the P0 amount-source drift from iter_26 is resolved.
Two-step checkout (line ~ noshow-confirm) works correctly and safely (single-click reverts after 3.5s; row removed on second click; counters increment atomically).
Per-bill draft state (`billD()` line 357) neatly isolates coupon/loyalty/discount per bill — leak from iter_26 fixed.
File is still 909 lines — beyond the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into logical modules for future maintainability.

Prepaid-vs-base amount semantics is the only lingering money-integrity inconsistency: pick either (a) prepaid = base booking charge (matches Arrivals badge, matches QA spec) or (b) prepaid = GST-inclusive amount (matches current seed) and apply uniformly across the No-Show and Cancel refund maths.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only two residual defects: (P1) QA-002 prepaid ₹9,450 vs spec ₹9,000 caused by GST-inclusive prepaid in the seed forEach at line 355; (P2) checkin-close-button text missing '✕' prefix at line 699. All other 25 audited QA items pass. iter_26 P0/P1 items (hard-coded roomAmt/adv, cross-screen amount drift, coupon leak, In-House 'leaving today' definition, extend over-collect guard, modify adults/past-cin guards, kebab OTA colour) are fully resolved.
rca of the issue: arr.forEach at line 355 sets OTA prepaid to Math.round(bookingCharge(a)*1.05) — this bakes 5% GST into what the No-Show dialog reads as 'Prepaid / advance'. The QA-002/QA-009 spec expects prepaid = base bookingCharge (rate × nights). Either drop the ×1.05 in the seed OR update the spec so that prepaid is GST-inclusive and refund-due = 9450 − 4725 = 4725. Recommend the former (base amount) because Arrivals row `arr[i].amt = RATE[type]` (line 355) and the PAY AT HOTEL/PREPAID badge use base pricing without GST elsewhere.
